svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A plot with t across (0 to 50) and |ζ(½ + it)| up (0 to 4). The ink curve starts at 1.46 at t = 0 and rises and falls, touching the axis ten times; the touch points are ten magenta dots, the first labelled 14.13. A red tag in the top right asks whether every nontrivial zero lies on this line: an open problem.
